title: Notification regarding Single Bench of Hon'ble the Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma will sit at 12:00 Noon on 24-08-2026.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 21;t August, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that Single Bench of Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma will sit at 12:00
noon on 24th August, 2026.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. N,. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ lg \Sg –1 c4 . Imphal, the 21st August, 2026

4. The Advocate General, Government of Manipur.

7. The Registrar (Vigilance)/(Translation Wing)/(Admn.), High Court of Manipur.

- He is requested to upload the same on official website.

19. The Concerned/Guard File.
